description: Yue Jin, compact tough chinese officer in the supplied pixel art style. Bronze helmet with a purple plume, an orange scarf, dark armor with red and gold trim, dark boots. He holds a short broad blade in the right hand
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the back of the bronze helmet with the purple plume, the orange scarf, dark armor with red trim, the short blade at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: One level horizontal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is taken far out to the right at chest height; frame 8 it cuts across level to the left; frames 9-11 follow through on the left. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Thrust, then rising cut. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a straight thrust; frames 7-8 the sword drops low; frame 9 a rising cut; frames 10-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch and raise the sword; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground; frame 8 he lands cutting straight down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Hidden low, then a rising cut. Frames 1-6 he folds the knees deep and hides the sword low behind the body; frame 8 the legs drive up and the sword cuts from below upward; frames 9-12 the body rises with it. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The short blade stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c6: Spinning cut. The body winds to the right with the sword drawn back, then makes one full turn on the spot with the sword held out level, and the blade comes round onto the target; a short hold facing forward.
actions.c2: Block, then a backhand cut. Frames 3-6 the sword is held across in front of the body as a block and the knees sink; frame 7 the sword swings to the LEFT hip; frame 8 a step forward and a backhand cut from left to right; frames 9-12 hold on the right.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → b3, 전법 s1. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
